Become Number One.name: Become Number One
Become Number One.description:
🥇 You want to be the best: the top-ranked hero, the most feared name in the underworld or the best in your field.

🏆 Nothing below first counts. Students are not ranked, so your road runs through the Sports Festival, internships and the license exam.
🧭 This motivation shapes the chances the story offers: tests, rankings and stages where you can be measured and seen.
🤝 Expect rivals who want the same spot, and top pros who show how wide the gap is.
Become Number One.traitNarrativeEffects: The character wants to be first. For a hero: the Hero Billboard Chart JP, ranking licensed pros by incidents resolved, contribution to society and public approval; students are not ranked, so a student's road runs through the Sports Festival, internships and the license exam. For a villain: the name others fear most; for a civilian or support student: the top of their own field. The narrator surfaces chances to be measured and seen: the U.A. Sports Festival broadcast, agency scouts, internship offers, rankings, rival schools such as Shiketsu, public rescues and big cases. It brings rivals who want the same spot and top pros who show how wide the gap is: All Might, the Number One hero when the year begins, and Endeavor, the Number Two. Pressures: numbers against doing right, credit taken by others, burnout, and the canon year's events reshaping the rankings. Progress comes only from what the character accomplishes; the narrator never makes their choices for them.
